shared_or_similar_visual_information: A gray-filled portion of a plane diagram. On the left, use the selected gray unit cells of the four-by-four grid. On the right, use the gray area above the x-axis between the two branches of the parabola.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The cells marked gray specify a finite collection of occupied squares of the candidate shape. Right image: The shading selects the bounded region between the parabola and the x-axis from x = −5 to x = 5, whose top extends beyond the window.
Rationales: The left fill identifies a discrete collection of movable or occupied cells. The right fill identifies a continuous region up to a plotted boundary, requiring a graph-based area calculation.
